# Marina Contractor Insurance

> Specialized commercial insurance for marine and waterfront construction contractors — marine general liability, Jones Act & USL&H (Longshore) coverage, workers' compensation, builder's risk, equipment floaters (barges, cranes, pile drivers, dredges), commercial auto, and umbrella. A division of Contractors Choice Agency (founded 2005, licensed all 50 states, NPN 8608479). A-rated carriers, 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response.

Marina Contractor Insurance helps dock, pier, marina, and waterfront construction contractors get coverage that actually fits over-water work: marine GL without watercraft exclusions, Jones Act and USL&H for crews on navigable water, builder's risk for the structure under construction, and equipment floaters for the barges and pile drivers that make the work possible. We shop A-rated specialty marine markets and turn around the certificates and additional-insured endorsements your marina owners, ports, and developers require.

## Coverage lines
- [Marine General Liability](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/marine-general-liability): Third-party bodily injury & property damage for over-water operations — without the watercraft exclusions standard policies hide.
- [Jones Act & USL&H (Longshore)](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/jones-act-uslh): Mandatory federal coverage for maritime workers on navigable water — the gap standard workers' comp does not fill.
- [General Liability (Upland)](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/general-liability): Third-party coverage for landside yard, shop, and staging operations.
- [Workers' Compensation](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/workers-compensation): Landside coverage for marine crews, coordinated with Jones Act and USL&H.
- [Commercial Auto](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/commercial-auto): Trucks, trailers, and lowboys hauling dock sections and materials, including hired/non-owned.
- [Inland Marine / Equipment](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/inland-marine-equipment): Scheduled coverage for barges, cranes, pile drivers, dredges, and tugs at replacement cost.
- [Builder's Risk](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/builders-risk): Course-of-construction coverage for the dock, pier, or marina under construction — fire, storm, wave, and theft.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](https://marinacontractorinsurance.com/services/umbrella-excess-liability): Layered limits to $10M+ for port, Corps of Engineers, and marina-owner requirements.
